title: The Treaty of Versailles is a 1919 text, not a cause by itself
summary: Wikisource publishes the treaty. What it caused is a separate, contested question.
body: Wikisource publishes the Treaty of Versailles, the 1919 peace treaty with Germany after the First World War. The text is a document: territorial clauses, reparations, and restrictions. Whether those terms produced the Second World War is an interpretation. Some historians have given them great weight; others have argued that later German decisions were not dictated by the treaty. This card establishes only that the treaty is a real, readable instrument. The causal argument stays on the unsourced causes card until a historian is cited.
